summary: Iteration 7: tested the Player Account page (/app/account) and the Staff Admin roles (owner /admin/staff, staff login and permissions, staff deposit review, backend 403s). New pytest file test_staff_roles.py plus the existing test_account_update.py: 61/61 pass. One critical frontend bug found and fixed: the 'staff' route sat under /app instead of /admin, so the owner's nav-admin-staff link (/admin/staff) hit the '*' catch-all and was sent to the landing page '/'. I moved the route into the /admin block. After the fix the owner Staff page works: the list shows Owner + Staff rows, create works, a duplicate email shows a toast, Disable leads to a 403 on login, Enable leads to 200. Staff login lands on /admin with 'Staff Console' shown, and Game Providers/Loss Rewards/Staff/Credit Config are hidden. Direct visits to /admin/settings, /admin/providers, /admin/staff and /admin/loss-rewards redirect to /admin. User adjust/suspend buttons and the payment-setup link are hidden for staff. Staff approved a deposit in the UI (reviewed_by=staff@aetheria.io), replied to and resolved a ticket, and resolved fraud alerts. Account page: rename updates the sidebar, a wrong password shows a toast, mismatched passwords show a toast, a password change makes the old password return 401 and the new one work (restored), and an email change sets email_verified=false and shows the verify banner (restored). Regression checks passed: the owner sees all 14 nav items, the OTP toggle works, and logout works.

minor.issue: If a player changes their email and then changes it back to the original verified address, email_verified stays false. A verification email is also sent to every interim address. Expected, but may confuse players.
A staff user who changes their email gets email_verified=false and a verification email (only role 'admin' is exempt). This is harmless because staff can't deposit, but it is inconsistent.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: the 'staff' route was nested under /app (as /app/staff), so /admin/staff redirected the owner to '/' (landing page)

issues: The temporary password field is type=text, so it shows in plain text. This is probably intentional (so the owner can share it), but consider a show/hide toggle.

action_items: Review my App.js fix: the staff route now sits inside the /admin route block
Optional: skip email_verified=false when a user changes their email back to the original verified one; exempt the staff role from email re-verification
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: /admin/staff route was in the wrong parent (fixed)
ProtectedRoute role='admin' allows any non-user role. That is correct for staff, but any future role would also get in; consider an explicit allow-list
update_account: the find_one duplicate-email check isn't atomic; on a race, the unique index raises DuplicateKeyError (500). Wrap it in try/except and return 400
Disabling staff reuses status 'suspended', and get_current_user blocks existing sessions right away (verified 403)
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test_staff_* users (deleted by email/id) and TEST_ tickets (deleted by id). Created 3 small $10 USDT TRC20 TEST_ deposits for demo: 2 approved by staff (demo credit balance +$100), 1 rejected. Resolved the velocity fraud alerts those deposits created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials restored: demo@aetheria.io/Demo@12345 (name 'Demo Player', email_verified true), staff@aetheria.io/Staff@12345 (name 'Staff Tester', active), admin@aetheria.io/Admin@12345. Run pytest tests/test_staff_roles.py tests/test_account_update.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Each run approves one $10 demo deposit.
rca of the issue: /admin/staff redirected to '/': in App.js, <Route path='staff'> was placed inside the <Route path='/app'> children, so the router had no /admin/staff route and fell through to <Route path='*'> -> Navigate('/'). Fix: move it into the /admin children, wrapped in ProtectedRoute role='owner'.
